notes.title: Baby Storm - watch gameplay live!
notes.content:
Watch over unpredictable kids as they unleash chaos in your kindergarten!

Maintain order, run, clean, and feed your way to the highest score, in solo or local multiplayer mode with up to 4 players!

You are equipped with toys for playtime, food for mealtime, wipes, diapers for you-know-what time, and even a nifty radio-controlled vacuum robot to help you with cleaning. If you’re alone in this task, there are useful power-ups: you can use aids such as maracas to soothe children. Fulfill your mission to become the best babysitter in the universe!
